question: Between the third Thursday and fourth Wednesday in Jan 1939, what was the net total capital inflow or outflow in thousands of dollars between the US and Latin America?
raw_response:
I treated the period as the week ending Jan. 25, 1939, and combined the Latin America changes/transactions in the capital-movement tables. The net was a capital inflow.

<FINAL_ANSWER>1,461 inflow</FINAL_ANSWER>
